build_rtmdet_detector: build an RTMDet single-stage object detector with backbone, neck, and bbox_head modules
create_rtmdet_with_syncbn: create an RTMDet detector that uses SyncBatchNorm for multi-GPU distributed training
run_rtmdet_loss: run the RTMDet loss computation on a batch of input images and ground truth samples
run_rtmdet_predict: run RTMDet prediction on input images to get bounding boxes, labels, and scores
review_rtmdet_extract_feat: review the RTMDet extract_feat method that passes inputs through backbone and neck
